Who We Are

MORE THAN A CLUB — IT'S A COMMUNITY

Dulwich Table Tennis Club is South London's premier table tennis club, based at Harris Girls Academy in SE22. Founded in 2008, we've grown to become one of the most respected clubs in the region, producing national champions and nurturing players from age 6 to 60+.

🏆
Championship Heritage
2× Six Nations Champions, multiple national titles, and countless regional victories. Our legacy speaks for itself.
👨‍🏫
Elite Coaching Staff
Led by Former England No.1 Abdul Wuraola — a true legend of British table tennis with international titles to his name.
🌍
Inclusive Community
Players from age 6+ of all backgrounds and ability levels. From absolute beginners to competitive athletes — all are welcome.

Questions

GOT QUESTIONS? WE'VE GOT ANSWERS.

Do I need prior experience to join the club? ▼
Not at all! Our club welcomes players of all levels, from complete beginners to advanced competitors. We offer coaching and practice sessions tailored to different skill levels so everyone can improve and enjoy the game.
What equipment do I need to bring? ▼
If you have your own paddle, feel free to bring it. However, we also provide paddles and balls for beginners, so you can start playing without any special equipment.
When and how often do you meet? ▼
We hold regular sessions at Harris Girls Academy, East Dulwich Grove, SE22 0NR. Saturday sessions run from 1pm to 4pm. Weekday coaching is available by appointment. Contact us on WhatsApp at +447821763379 for the latest schedule and to book your place.
Is the club open to juniors and adults? ▼
Yes! We offer sessions for juniors (from age 6), adults, and seniors. Our goal is to create a fun, inclusive environment where players of all ages can learn and compete.
How do I book a coaching session? ▼
Booking is simple — just message us on WhatsApp at +447821763379 or fill in our online enquiry form. We'll get back to you quickly to confirm your session time and venue.
Are there tournaments and competitions? ▼
Absolutely! We run monthly internal tournaments and support members in entering local and national competitions. Whether you're playing for fun or chasing a ranking, we'll help you get there.
